main_text.p: in hanc ipsam ad Hebræos, causas reddit varias taciti tum nominis, tum Apostolatus, de quibus nos parte ultimâ. Quanquam non Primasij, sed Haimonis hic credatur esse Commentarius.

XXXVIII. Iunilius, Episcopus Africanus, familiaris Primasio, de quo itidem meminit Cassiodorus Libro divin. Lect: De partibus divinæ Legis ad Primasium, L.1.C.vi. inter Paulinas, recenset Epistolam ad Hebræos.
XXXIX. Evodius sive Ennodius Episcopus Ticinensis, clarus sub Anastasio, sexto itidem ineunte sæculo; Opusculo II. Apostolo æquè Paulo proclamante, Obe-dite ductoribus vestris Hebr. xiii.

XL. Johannes Maurentius, florens itidem sub Anastasio ; responsione ad Hormisdam Papam, citat locum Hebr. XI. de Fide Enochi & Noæ, sub nomine Pauli Apostoli. Idem, in Dialogis varia profert ex Cap. I. & II. Epistolæ, eodem Pauli expresso nomine.

page.notes: Printed "XXXVIII", "XXXIX", "XL", "XLI" are paragraph numbers, so they are kept as paragraph openings, not headings. Running head word "Autore" is partly obscured by ink spots; read as "Autore" with doubt. The page number "128" is partly blurred. The catchword "no)" is set in bold at the right below the last line, completing "Sabinia-no)". Smudges and ink spots in the margins are not transcribed.
